timing_note: Frozen after the cascade's prospective test was opened, but before training either compute/capacity control.
independent_ensemble: Train a second independent T-PLE model with the residual branch's parameter budget and seed offset, then average its prediction with the original anchor.
wide_single_model: Train one T-PLE model matched to the combined anchor-plus-residual parameter count.
training_budget: The ensemble matches the cascade's two training phases; the wide model matches allocated parameter capacity but uses one training phase.
validation_gate: The cascade must beat each control in at least 7/12 validation cells, have positive mean paired gain against each control, and have positive mean paired gain against each control within both task families.
test_role: Descriptive because the cascade test metrics were already opened before these controls were frozen.
